kinds.name: Member
kinds.description: A workspace member, identified by a client-supplied email address (MemberEmail, x-semantic-client-minted). Minted outside this API — the member's user account exists in the IdP; the API only references the email to grant/revoke workspace membership. Never created, fetched, or deleted as a standalone entity; participates only in the WorkspaceMemberMembership edge (addMember / searchMembers / removeMember).

kinds.name: Workspace
kinds.description: A workspace entity, identified by its server-minted workspaceKey. Established via createWorkspace (POST /workspaces), observed via getWorkspace, revoked via deleteWorkspace (a soft-delete). restoreWorkspace (POST /workspaces/{workspaceKey}/restoration) restores a soft-deleted workspace — the RestoreLifecycle template (#426) drives create → soft-delete → restore so restore is exercised against a recently-deleted workspace rather than a live one (which 404s).

kinds.name: Version
kinds.description: A version entity, identified by its server-minted versionKey — a snapshot of a file's content at a point in time. Established via createVersion (POST /versions) for a file, observed via getVersion, revoked via deleteVersion (a hard delete, 204, no restoration). createVersion was unblocked by camunda-hub#27610, which lifted the prior restriction on versioning a file located inside a process application (camunda-hub#25801).
